video_id,
tag_id,

#{videoId,jdbcType=INTEGER},

mapper.select: SELECT t.tag_id AS tagId, t.tag_name AS tagName, COUNT(DISTINCT vt.video_id) AS videoCount FROM t_tag t JOIN t_video_tag vt ON vt.tag_id = t.tag_id GROUP BY t.tag_id, t.tag_name HAVING videoCount >= #{minCount} ORDER BY videoCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.video_id, v.video_name, v.original_title, v.overview, v.tagline, v.budget, v.revenue, v.popularity, v.vote_average, v.vote_count, v.runtime, v.release_date, v.original_language, v.poster_path, v.heat_score FROM t_video_info v JOIN t_video_tag vt ON vt.video_id = v.video_id WHERE vt.tag_id = #{tagId} ORDER BY v.heat_score DESC, v.popularity DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
